original_statement:
What did you do? List the exact steps to reproduce, in order. stack/compose-jobs/docker-compose-armada-watchtower-e2e.yml lines 56-58 bind-mount /home/rix/code/git_puller/repos/armada-nitro/.worktrees/worker-arn-752/stack/scripts/armada-watchtower-e2e-job.py, .../script/WatchtowerScenario.s.sol and .../env/gates/watchtower/prepare.ts into /src/armada-nitro. That worktree was deleted when arn-752 landed (exophial reaps it), so 'python3 stack/scripts/armada-watchtower-e2e.py --state-n-allocation-lamports 1000000 --state-n-plus1-allocation-lamports 2000000' now runs the job against missing mount sources.
What did you expect to happen? The job takes all of its code from the env image (cerc/armada-nitro-env:local), rebuilt from this repo so it contains stack/scripts/armada-watchtower-e2e-job.py, script/WatchtowerScenario.s.sol and env/gates/watchtower/prepare.ts; the job file has no host bind mounts of repo files. Checks: 1) Behavior: 'python3 stack/scripts/armada-watchtower-e2e.py --state-n-allocation-lamports 1000000 --state-n-plus1-allocation-lamports 2000000' prints JSON where scenario_a.watcher_enabled = true, scenario_a.challenge_tx, scenario_a.response_tx and scenario_a.check_line are non-empty, scenario_a.response_latency_seconds >= 0, 1500000 < scenario_a.payout_lamports <= 2000000; scenario_b.watcher_enabled = false, scenario_b.challenge_tx and scenario_b.check_line are non-empty, scenario_b.response_tx is empty, 0 < scenario_b.payout_lamports < 1500000. 2) grep_absent: patterns '/home/' and '.worktrees/' in stack/compose-jobs/docker-compose-armada-watchtower-e2e.yml.
What actually happened? Include the exact error text or output. The job file bind-mounts three source files from /home/rix/code/git_puller/repos/armada-nitro/.worktrees/worker-arn-752/, which no longer exists; the gate passed only while that worktree was present.
Which surface or component? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) stack/compose-jobs/docker-compose-armada-watchtower-e2e.yml (E15b, arn-752)
What environment and version? (OS, app/gateway build or commit, network) armada-nitro main 564ef7f; fixturenet E12 (~/deployments/armada-fixturenet-e12, compose); env image cerc/armada-nitro-env:local
Is it reproducible? (always / intermittently / once) — and how often. always
What is the impact / severity? Who is blocked and how badly? The landed E15b gate cannot run: its job's code comes from host paths that no longer exist, so E15c (arn-78f), which builds on this gate, is blocked.
What activity was underway when this was found? (ODC Activity — e.g. testing, code review, normal usage, reproduction attempt) operational use: reviewing landed fixturenet jobs after E15b (arn-752) merged
What condition or event exposed the defect? (ODC Trigger — e.g. a config change, concurrent access, a boundary/edge-case input, an unusual workload) the worker's worktree .worktrees/worker-arn-752 was reaped when arn-752 landed
restatement: The armada-watchtower-e2e fixturenet gate's compose job file bind-mounts three source files from a worker worktree (.worktrees/worker-arn-752/...) that exophial deletes once the worker's pebble lands, so the gate can no longer run. The job must instead get all of its code from the env image cerc/armada-nitro-env:local, rebuilt from this repository so the image already contains stack/scripts/armada-watchtower-e2e-job.py, script/WatchtowerScenario.s.sol, and env/gates/watchtower/prepare.ts. The compose job file must carry no bind mount of a file under a host path. With that fix in place, running the e2e script with the stated lamport amounts must print JSON showing the watched-payout scenario and the unwatched-payout scenario each behaving as the report specifies.

restatement_clauses.text: The compose job file stack/compose-jobs/docker-compose-armada-watchtower-e2e.yml must contain no reference to a path under /home/ and no reference to a .worktrees/ directory.

Running `python3 stack/scripts/armada-watchtower-e2e.py --state-n-allocation-lamports 1000000 --state-n-plus1-allocation-lamports 2000000` must print JSON where scenario_a.watcher_enabled = true, scenario_a.challenge_tx, scenario_a.response_tx and scenario_a.check_line are non-empty, scenario_a.response_latency_seconds >= 0, and 1500000 < scenario_a.payout_lamports <= 2000000.

The same run's JSON must show scenario_b.watcher_enabled = false, scenario_b.challenge_tx and scenario_b.check_line are non-empty, scenario_b.response_tx is empty, and 0 < scenario_b.payout_lamports < 1500000.

goal: Restore the armada-watchtower-e2e fixturenet gate so it runs entirely from the rebuilt env image, with no dependency on a deleted worker worktree.
acceptance_criteria: The watchtower e2e gate's compose file no longer names a file under a host user directory or under a worker worktree directory.
When the gate runs the first scenario, the watcher catches the operator's late challenge, the operator answers it, and the payout lands in the expected higher range.
When the gate runs the second scenario, no watcher is present, the operator's challenge goes unanswered, and the payout lands in the expected lower range.
